rows.grounds: bahuvrihi compound of tad (that) and manas (mind)

items.question: Can a practitioner absorbed in that state be harmed when subjected to cutting?
premises: A person may undergo the act of being cut.
A person may have gone to that higher state.
A person may have the mind fixed on that state.
items.inference: One who has gone to that state and whose mind is fixed on it is not truly cut even while being cut.
items.plain_english: Just as one who has gone to that state, with mind fixed on that, is not cut even while being cut.
